rule:
Ratchet: score a rung on the frozen simulated set and the real dev gate; log to ratchet.json.

    python3 ratchet.py score <rung> <frozen_bank> [--decide "reason"]   # rung = ckpt name, or 'rolling' (classical)
    python3 ratchet.py rescore <frozen_bank>                              # re-score every logged rung on a new set

Frozen score = capture = net revenue / perfect-foresight net revenue, summed over the 3 battery durations (1, 2, 4 h)
of each path-year and averaged over the path-years of the frozen simulated set (each path-year counts the same; a
dollar-weighted sum would be dominated by a few scarcity years).  Dev capture is averaged the same way over the 10
real dev node-years.  Rule: keep a rung if it beats the incumbent's frozen
score by > 0.01 AND passes the dev gate: its aggregate capture on the real dev node-years (ERCOT 2019 and 2021 at
4 hubs, CAISO Aug-Dec 2023 at NP15/SP15; all 3 durations) is not more than 0.01 below the incumbent's.

rungs.name: rolling
rungs.change: classical rolling-horizon LP on day-ahead prices (incumbent)

rungs.name: r1_v1
rungs.change: MLP value-curve policy trained by policy search on sim v1 (GridSim merit-order prices, no scarcity curve, no outage weather, no RT noise); 45 path-years
rungs.why: frozen +0.491 but dev gate failed: dev capture 0.483 vs incumbent 0.593 (-0.110); the v1 prices have no scarcity, so the policy cycles on small spreads and is empty when spikes come

rungs.name: r2_v2
rungs.change: same network and policy search, trained on sim v2 (80 ERCOT path-years from 2018/2020/2022 inputs with dev-calibrated scarcity)
rungs.why: frozen 0.767 vs incumbent R0 0.489 (+0.278 > 0.01); dev 0.598 vs 0.593 (gate: not more than 0.01 below) -> kept, new incumbent

rungs.name: r3_v3
rungs.change: train on all 120 ERCOT path-years + 45 CAISO-like path-years (CISO fleet, duck-curve solar, carbon price, $1000-2000 caps), 2,500 steps
rungs.why: frozen 0.7489 vs incumbent R2 0.7465 (+0.0024, below the 0.01 margin) -> rejected, although dev improved (0.623 vs 0.598)

rungs.name: r4_v3
rungs.change: fine-tune R3 on the same 165 path-years with longer windows (21 days), batch 64, lower learning rate (900 steps)
rungs.why: frozen 0.7580 vs incumbent R2 0.7465 (+0.0115 > 0.01); dev 0.637 vs 0.598 -> kept; released

rescores.reason: sim v2 (dev-calibrated ORDC scarcity, cold outages, gas-turbine derate, RT noise, DA expectation) replaced v1: new frozen set, every rung re-scored and decisions re-taken in order

R1.why: frozen +0.043 over R0 but dev gate still fails (-0.110)

rescores.reason: the frozen set gained 9 CAISO-like path-years (sim v3 = v2 + a CAISO family on the real CISO fleet); every rung re-scored and decisions re-taken in order
